The facility does not have the dates of administration for treatments recorded in the medical records. A 6-week-old female
dachshund puppy (microchip #0020) is currently being treated for a left eye injury. The facility representative stated the
issue was observed on 3-July-2026 and per the program of veterinary care has been applying neopolybac ointment three
times daily. When inquiring where this is being documented on a medical record the representative stated she has not
documented the administration of the medication for this puppy.
Failure to record the dates for all treatments administered does not allow for APHIS officials to determine if adequate
veterinary care has been provided for animals covered under the Animal Welfare Act. The licensee must ensure that the
names of all vaccines and treatments administered, and the dates of administration are recorded and maintained.
Correct by from this day 21-July-2026 and going forward.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with the facility representative.
